stage: F. PX4 SITL and time-aligned evidence
scope: Known empty environment, nominal unloaded E2 configuration. One linked sequence with three qualification intervals; one deterministic run establishes interface function, not robustness or real-flight performance.
physics: Registered SUPER and native Qingyu visual assembly. Eight integrated bending links, nominal drives, 0.5 ms physics, 4 ms HIL IMU clock. Temporary world support only before simulated takeoff; no external wrench or pose reset after release.
loops: Synthetic accelerometer, gyro, magnetometer, barometer and GPS -> native EKF2 -> native PX4 position/rate controllers -> four HIL actuator channels -> MuJoCo rotor thrust. No simulator pose/attitude or simulator-truth feedback into flight control. All communication within the NUC. No physical flight.
task: After free lift-off settle for 9 s, hover at launch +0.65 m for 5 s, translate east by 0.60 m with a 4 s cosine ramp and hold for 4 s, maintain the new position for the 14 s E1 bend/return profile at phi=180 degrees, then hold for 3 s. Fixed yaw = east. Time zero for phases is release of launch support.
outputs: Time-indexed HIL wire, MuJoCo full state and applied thrust, flight and arm requests/issued/response, native PX4 ULog, typed ROS1 bag, per-phase time index, clock alignment and independent reconstruction. Record failure reasons. Simulated sensor accuracy, motor conversion and inertia are nominal assumptions.
paper: Standalone candidate preview. Admit the F chain only after reconstruction, no automatic manuscript or gate-passage claims.
